P.name: Hextech Capacitor
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Jayce''' switches between either {{sbc|{{ai|Transform Mercury Hammer|Jayce|Hammer Stance}}}} or {{sbc|{{ai|Transform Mercury Cannon|Jayce|Cannon Stance}}}}, he gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|30 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

Q.name: To the Skies!
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target enemy's location over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon arrival, he smashes his hammer to the ground to deal {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies within an area and {{tip|slow}} them for 2 seconds.
Q.description2: ''To the Skies!'' deals {{as|10 '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description3: ''{{ai|Lightning Field|Jayce}} can be cast during the dash.''

Q.name: Shock Blast
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' fires an electric bolt in the target direction that detonates upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
Q.description2: If the bolt passes through ''{{ai|Acceleration Gate|Jayce}}'', it becomes supercharged: increasing its {{ccs|damage by 40%|physical}} as well as its speed, range and explosion radius.

W.name: Lightning Field
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' surrounds himself with an electric field for 4 seconds that deals {{as|magic damage}} every second to nearby enemies.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|35 to 110 6}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|35*4 to 110*4 6}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}

W.name: Hyper Charge
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' empowers his next 3 [[basic attack]]s within 4 seconds to deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and gain {{sti|attack speed|{{as|360% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.

''Hyper Charge's'' '''total''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
W.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|70 to 110 6}}% AD}}|Total Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|70*3 to 110*3 6}}% AD}}}}
W.description2: ''Hyper Charge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Jayce's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Thundering Blow
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' {{tip|root|roots}} the target enemy over the cast time, then swings his hammer at them to deal {{as|magic damage}}, capped against {{tip|monsters}}, and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} 600 units.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|8 to 22 6}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|200 to 700 6}}}}
E.description3: '''''Jayce''' is unable to cast {{ai|To the Skies!|Jayce}} or {{ai|Shock Blast|Jayce}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after Thundering Blow's cast time.''

E.name: Acceleration Gate
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' deploys an energy gate centered at the target location, lasting for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. '''Jayce''' and allied champions can move through the gate to gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 3 seconds, with the duration refreshing continuously while within the gate.

R.name: Transform Mercury Cannon
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Cannon.png||{{sbc|Cannon Stance}}}}, receiving access to its {{tip|abilities}}, becoming {{tip|ranged}} with {{sti|500 attack range}}, and empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} to reduce the target's {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} by {{pp|key=%|20 to 35 for 4|1 to 16}} for 5 seconds.

R.name: Transform Mercury Hammer
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Hammer.png||{{sbc|Hammer Stance}}}}, receiving access to its {{tip|abilities}}, becoming {{tip|melee}} with {{sti|125 attack range}}, gaining {{pp|5 to 26 for 4|1 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{fd|7.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, and empowering his next basic attack to deal {{as|{{pp|25 to 130 for 4|1 to 16}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
R.description2: '''Jayce''' begins the game with ''Transform'' but cannot increase its rank. Instead, his basic {{tip|abilities}} each have 6 ranks.
